title: senna macrophylla
intro: Senna macrophylla, commonly known as piñoncillo, is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family, specifically the subfamily Caesalpinioideae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues such as constipation and diarrhea, due to its ability to stimulate bowel movements and improve gut health. The therapeutic actions of Senna macrophylla can be attributed to its anthraquinone glycosides, which have laxative properties and are also used to relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The bioactive constituents present in Senna macrophylla include anthraquinone glycosides, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
